tbesh_html:
1) round thing, surroundings, round about, that which surrounds, that which is round
1a) environs
1a1) surrounding places
1a2) round about (adv)
1b) round table

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a divan (as enclosing the room); abstractly (adverbial) around
strongs_1890.derivation: plural masculine מְסִבִּים; or feminine מְסִבּוֹת; from H5437 (סָבַב);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: that compass about, (place) round about, at table.
